text: Curating for “Holets”, an exhibition that reimagines the legendary venue of the Aran Valley and that takes as its backbone the figure of the holet, the elf, one of the creatures people stopped believing in a long time ago.

Berini, the artist, proposes to hybridise contemporary aesthetics with traditional images belonging to the folklore of her home territory. Rural influences, when placed in relation with urban aesthetics and references, generate a conglomerate that shows us it is possible to make two imaginaries coexist that are usually presented to us as separate and even opposite.
